# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Infant (born between June and August of the year Anne and Gilbert returned to Four Winds; shortened by September of the following year)  <sub>[v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000), [v4 c40 P53](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0053), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c19 P10](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds Harbor, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v4 c5 P1](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0001), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jem  <sub>[v4 c34 P24](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0024), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>; Little Jem  <sub>[v4 c31 P10](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0010), [v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010), [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Little Jem is a plump, healthy boy with curly red hair, frank hazel eyes, a fine nose, and a steady, humorous mouth. He was noted at birth for his exceptionally well-shaped ears and white complexion. He grows rapidly into a sturdy, well-built child with dimpled elbows.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c19 P14](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0014), [v4 c19 P20](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0020), [v4 c34 P17](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0017), [v4 c35 P4](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)_

## Personality

Little Jem is an energetic, reliable, and curious boy who never breaks a promise. Though not regarded as academically brilliant, he is a thorough, all-round student with a practical, inquisitive nature, preferring to investigate facts and science for himself through direct experiment. He is an outdoors lover with a passion for sports, fishing, hunting, and woodcraft, and harbors an intense desire to grow up and become a general or a soldier.

_Sources: [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P11](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0011), [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c4 P43](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0043), [v5 c17 P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041), [v5 c35 P11](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0011), [v5 c35 P20](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0020)_

## History

James Matthew Blythe was born in the house of dreams at Four Winds Harbor to Anne and Gilbert Blythe. His arrival brought immense comfort to his parents following the loss of their first child. He was named after Captain Jim Boyd and Matthew Cuthbert. Soon after his birth, the family relocated to Ingleside in Glen St. Mary, where he grew up alongside his younger siblings and played frequently in Rainbow Valley. As he grew into a sturdy schoolboy, he developed a deep love for nature and outdoor adventures, becoming an expert fisherman and woodcrafter. At thirteen, after completing his early education at the Glen school, he left home to attend Queen's Academy in Charlottetown.

_Sources: [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c34 P0](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0000), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 c40 P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017), [v4 c40 P58](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0058), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 c3 P0](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0000), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 c3 P12](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0012), [v5 c31 P10](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0010), [v5 c35 P9](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0009)_
